name: election-at-30
description: Thirty residents, a government sitting from the first tick and told so in its own perception, an election inside the first day, and up to two game-days. The largest cast an election has been held with. Funded at $6.00 a resident - the level the 50-resident run and run 29 both used - so the $100 model budget is the thing that ends the run, not empty wallets.
